holders.description: Each holder before and after, then the new investors; empty when the round was not modelled.

modelled.description: False when the round could not be modelled, which why says; the cap table passes through it unchanged.

month.description: The month its money arrives; its first day is the round's day.

new_shares.description: The shares the money buys, whole shares of the price (RND-SHARE).

post_money.description: The post-money valuation: the shares fully diluted after, at the price.

price_per_share.description: The price per share: the pre-money valuation divided by the shares fully diluted before, cut down to 4 decimals.

raised.description: What those shares cost: at most the money planned, the rest buying no whole share.

row.description: The funding row of the forecast it is.

examples: No pre-money valuation is planned, so the round has no price to model: add one to the funding row
